steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the required event title so publishing can proceed.
Choose the Auction stage's first available template before adding items.
Add the required auction line item.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.

args.goal: On the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave each clause mode as "None", leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, and click Done; stop on the Auction create screen showing the terms configuration saved

steps.note: Configure the two optional clauses and leave mandatory acceptance disabled; no catalog domain step can perform this exact terms workflow.
Invite one QA vendor to receive and bid on the event.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's Auction bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Verify the first optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the second optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Quote 100 for every line without requiring mandatory clause acceptance.
Assert that the vendor submission succeeded.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Assert that the buyer sees the vendor's direct bid response.
